title: Eternal revises Blinkit store target as Q2 net profit rises 92%
summary: Blinkit’s quick-commerce margins improved for a sixth straight quarter, while Zomato sustained food-delivery growth through customer acquisition investments.

score_reasons: +3 Close, specific exposure to this company
+2 Earnings or guidance at a related company
direction_reasons: ACQUISITION cuts both ways — growth against capital, cost or execution risk
watch_next: margin trend versus the previous quarter
order book or loan book disclosure
RAVEL.why_it_matters: This reaches the company through a close, specific exposure via its customer exposure to Blinkit. The parts of the business most likely touched are revenue, margin, balance sheet. Classified as earnings.

ai_analysis.revenue_effect: Positively affected. Expanding Blinkit's store footprint broadens distribution reach and availability for Ravelcare's personal care and beauty products, driving higher order volume through quick commerce.
ai_analysis.margin_effect: Unclear. Higher volume scale could improve operating leverage, but platform listing fees, slotting costs, and promotional discounts required by quick commerce platforms could pressure gross margins.
ai_analysis.cost_effect: Increased operating expenses tied to higher channel marketing, inventory stocking across expanded dark stores, and logistics needed to maintain rapid stock replenishment.
ai_analysis.competitive_effect: May strengthen market position if Ravelcare secures prime shelf placement in new dark stores, though competing beauty brands will also battle for visibility in the same channel.
ai_analysis.regulatory_effect: No direct regulatory impact identified from this expansion announcement.
ai_analysis.short_term: Potential inventory pull and higher primary sales over the next 0-3 months as Blinkit stocks up new dark stores ahead of local launches.
ai_analysis.medium_long_term: Accelerated shift toward quick commerce as a core sales channel over 3+ months, driving higher off-take if product turnover remains robust.
ai_analysis.second_order_effects: Growing channel concentration risk on quick commerce platforms, potentially shifting pricing power toward the aggregator during contract renegotiations.
ai_analysis.key_uncertainty: The specific shelf-space allocation and commercial terms negotiated between Ravelcare and Blinkit for the new stores.
monitor_next: Pace of Blinkit's new dark store rollouts and geographic coverage
Ravelcare's sales contribution and growth metrics from quick-commerce channels
Changes in platform take-rates, listing fees, or trade margins
Product stock-out rates and fulfillment reliability across quick-commerce dark stores
